title: Open DS overlay
description: The user's layer on top of a source scheme: changed answers, then changed picks, usage rules and tokens, each with a why and a because. The build joins it with the source. Open DS writes into it only when an upgrade migration renames a path.

$comment.description: A note for the person who opens the file.

id.description: The id of a new scheme that the user owns. Leave it out to keep the source's id; then upgrades follow the source.

name.description: The name of a new scheme that the user owns. Set it with id.

version.description: The version of a new scheme that the user owns. Set it with id. The lockfile records it.

source.description: The source scheme this overlay changes: a link, not a copy.

version.description: The source scheme version the overlay was written against.

answers.description: Changed answers. A changed answer moves no value: it opens a review of what cites it.

option.description: The chosen option id of that question.

why.description: Why this entry differs from the source, in plain words.

because.description: The question ids this answer follows from. Leave it out to keep the source's.

picks.description: Changed theme picks, by brand and mode.

brand.description: The brand id, such as default.

mode.description: The theme mode: base for picks that hold in both modes, or light or dark.

value.description: The token reference the pick points at.

because.description: The question ids this entry follows from. At least one; each must be a question the scheme answers.

why.description: Why this entry differs from the source, in plain words.

use.description: What to use in this situation.

not.description: What not to use in this situation.

example.description: An example of the rule in use.

because.description: The question ids this entry follows from. At least one; each must be a question the scheme answers.

why.description: Why this entry differs from the source, in plain words.

tokens.description: Changed primitive, semantic or component tokens, by path.

path.description: The token path, from the tier.

value.description: The new value: a token reference for a semantic or component token, a raw value for a primitive.

because.description: The question ids this entry follows from. At least one; each must be a question the scheme answers.

why.description: Why this entry differs from the source, in plain words.

reviewed.description: Review items the user confirmed as they are, by id, such as usage:hover-feedback.
